title: Digital Marketing for Small Businesses in Canada: Where to Start in 2026 | Code Kraft Solutions

facts.fact: Code Kraft Solutions states that its digital marketing packages start at $499 per month.
facts.quote: Our digital marketing packages start at **$499 per month** and cover social media posts and graphic design

facts.fact: Code Kraft Solutions says its digital marketing packages cover social media posts and graphic design, content writing, social media optimisation and, at higher tiers, boosted posts, lead forms, ad management, Google Ads and SEO.
facts.quote: cover social media posts and graphic design, content writing, social media optimisation and, at higher tiers, boosted posts, lead forms, ad management, Google Ads and SEO.

facts.fact: The page is published by Code Kraft Solutions, whose team is located in Toronto and Halifax.
facts.quote: Our team in Toronto & Halifax will review your requirements and share next steps.

facts.fact: The article states that Google Ads results can be measured within days.
facts.quote: Paid search ads put you in front of people actively searching for your service, with results you can measure within days.

facts.fact: The article recommends measuring cost per lead from paid campaigns, along with calls, form submissions and bookings rather than just likes.
facts.quote: Calls, form submissions and bookings — not just likes.
